import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x7f7f7f7f;
    static int n, m, s, t, p, c, d;
    static int[] x = new int[505], y = new int[505];
    static int max_flow, min_cost;
    static int edge_count = 1;
    static int[] head = new int[5000005], next_edge = new int[10000010], to_node = new int[10000010], capacity = new int[10000010], cost_edge = new int[10000010];
    static int[] dist = new int[5000005], parent = new int[5000005], last_edge = new int[5000005], flow_amount = new int[5000005];
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[5000005];

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
        next_edge[++edge_count] = head[u];
        to_node[edge_count] = v;
        capacity[edge_count] = cap;
        cost_edge[edge_count] = cst;
        head[u] = edge_count;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(visited, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        visited[s] = true;
        dist[s] = 0;
        flow_amount[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        parent[t] = -1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            visited[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = next_edge[i]) {
                if (capacity[i] > 0 && dist[to_node[i]] > dist[u] + cost_edge[i]) {
                    dist[to_node[i]] = dist[u] + cost_edge[i];
                    parent[to_node[i]] = u;
                    last_edge[to_node[i]] = i;
                    flow_amount[to_node[i]] = Math.min(flow_amount[u], capacity[i]);
                    if (!visited[to_node[i]]) {
                        visited[to_node[i]] = true;
                        q.offer(to_node[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return parent[t] != -1;
    }

    static void run_mcmf() {
        max_flow = 0;
        min_cost = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int current = t;
            max_flow += flow_amount[t];
            min_cost += flow_amount[t] * dist[t];
            while (current != s) {
                capacity[last_edge[current]] -= flow_amount[t];
                capacity[last_edge[current] ^ 1] += flow_amount[t];
                current = parent[current];
            }
        }
    }

    static int node(int layer, int node_id) {
        return layer * n + node_id;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        s = 0;
        t = n * 99 + 1;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
            int x_val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            addEdge(s, node(0, x_val), 1, 0);
            addEdge(node(0, x_val), s, 0, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            x[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            y[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 99; i++) {
            addEdge(node(i, 1), node(i + 1, 1), INF, 0);
            addEdge(node(i + 1, 1), node(i, 1), 0, 0);
            for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
                addEdge(node(i, j), node(i + 1, j), INF, c);
                addEdge(node(i + 1, j), node(i, j), 0, -c);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= p; k++) {
                    int cst = d * k * k - d * (k - 1) * (k - 1) + c;
                    addEdge(node(i, x[j]), node(i + 1, y[j]), 1, cst);
                    addEdge(node(i + 1, y[j]), node(i, x[j]), 0, -cst);
                    addEdge(node(i, y[j]), node(i + 1, x[j]), 1, cst);
                    addEdge(node(i + 1, x[j]), node(i, y[j]), 0, -cst);
                }
            }
        }

        run_mcmf();
        System.out.println(min_cost);
    }
}
